item.starboundmc.matter_manipulator.tool:
A relic from a distant universe.
Hold right-click to melt blocks with the mining beam (harder blocks take longer; speed upgrades accelerate, range upgrades widen)
Mining tier: 0 iron ore | 1 diamond & obsidian | 2 ancient debris
Wrong-tier blocks break but drop nothing
item.starboundmc.matter_manipulator_modu:
An upgrade component for the Matter Manipulator.
Levels 1/2/3 cost 1/2/4 modules.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.title: N.O.V.A.

gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.notice: Local interaction prototype. Story and ship state are not connected.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.welcome: Shipboard interface online. Select a diagnostic prompt to test streaming text and terminal controls.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.response.id: I am N.O.V.A.: Navigation, Operations & Vessel Assistant. This prototype uses scripted local dialogue.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.response.pr: This cyan-white construct is a synthetic visual interface. Its eye band and signal stability indicate my current state.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.response.st: The terminal is operating in local prototype mode. Story progression and shared ship state remain disconnected.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.incompa: This world uses a newer story-state format. Update the mod before operating this terminal.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.first_c: Shipboard systems are restored. Life signs detected; you are still alive. Welcome back.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.topic.n: I am N.O.V.A.: Navigation, Operations & Vessel Assistant. I monitor navigation, vessel operations, and onboard systems.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.topic.i: A high-intensity cosmic storm was detected. The ship was thrown off course and part of the navigation data was lost. Cause analysis is ongoing.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.topic.c: Position confirmed: orbit around a lush planet. Preliminary scans show a viable surface and no immediate lethal threats.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.topic.f: Propulsion systems are offline. The ship cannot leave orbit under its own power, but the teleporter remains available. I recommend restoring the sublight engine first.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.landing: Teleporter status is nominal. The communications link will connect automatically after you reach the planet surface. I recommend exploring the surface and using the Matter Manipulator to collect resources.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.current: Current task: use the ship teleporter to reach the planet surface. I will continue environmental analysis after you arrive.
Your first landing is confirmed. Communications are stable, and ship core systems remain online.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.late_jo: Core systems are restored. I am compiling the current situation and available tasks for you.

message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.emerge: Error. Critical system failure. Please reboot the system.

message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.core_o: Core systems restored. Assessing ship status.
message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.first_: I detected your arrival on the planet surface. The communications link is connected.
message.starboundmc.nova.tutorial.matter: I recommend exploring the planet surface and using the Matter Manipulator to collect resources. Hold right-click to mine with the laser.
message.starboundmc.nova.tutorial.wood_a: Congratulations. You acquired wood! Its uses are extensive; my calculations indicate that your survival probability has increased by 17 percentage points.
command.starboundmc.debug.engine.all_res: Debug: sublight engine and hyperdrive restored.
command.starboundmc.debug.engine.not_res: Engine restoration failed: reboot the core and complete First Landing first; the sublight engine must be online before the hyperdrive. The requested engine may also already be online.
